scripts.frontend:dev: cd frontend && PORT=$(node scripts/setup-dev-environment.js frontend) npm run dev -- --port ${PORT:-} --host
scripts.backend:dev: BACKEND_PORT=$(node scripts/setup-dev-environment.js backend) DISABLE_WORKTREE_ORPHAN_CLEANUP=1 RUST_LOG=debug cargo watch -w crates -x 'run --bin server'
scripts.mobile:dev: cd frontend/mobile-ui && export PORT=$(node ../../scripts/setup-dev-environment.js mobile-ui) && pnpm install && pnpm run dev --port ${PORT:-} --host 0.0.0.0
scripts.lint: npm run frontend:lint && npm run backend:lint
scripts.format: npm run frontend:format && npm run backend:format
scripts.check: npm run frontend:check && npm run backend:check
scripts.dev: npm run backend:dev & npm run frontend:dev
scripts.dev:qa: export FRONTEND_PORT=$(node scripts/setup-dev-environment.js frontend) && export BACKEND_PORT=$(node scripts/setup-dev-environment.js backend) && concurrently "npm run backend:dev:watch:qa" "npm run frontend:dev"
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run frontend:build && cd crates/desktop && pnpm exec tauri dev
scripts.desktop:build: npm run frontend:build && cd crates/desktop && pnpm exec tauri build && cd ../.. && bash scripts/sign-dmg.sh
scripts.desktop:build:debug: npm run frontend:build && cd crates/desktop && pnpm exec tauri build --debug
scripts.android:dev: npm run mobile:build && cd crates/desktop && pnpm exec tauri android dev
scripts.android:build: npm run mobile:build && cd crates/desktop && pnpm exec tauri android build --target aarch64
scripts.android:build:debug: npm run mobile:build && cd crates/desktop && pnpm exec tauri android build --target aarch64 --debug
